title: PostgreSQL: add sqlx postgres feature and dual-backend URL routing
description: Add sqlx postgres feature flag to all crates. Implement database URL routing: if URL starts with postgres://, use PgPool; if sqlite://, use SqlitePool. Both paths share the same sqlx query macros (use DATABASE_URL env var in build or query_as! with explicit type hints). Blocked on: stoa-b38f9c00.
